name: tara
description: Read-only access to Tahoe's data through the Tahoe public tools. Use for scientific and drug-discovery analyses that benefit from large-scale single-cell perturbational transcriptomics, including phenotypic profiling, mechanism-of-action inference, pathway-response and cell-state analysis, and comparing drug responses across cell lines. Look up which drugs, doses, cell lines and genes are covered; read drug annotations (targets, mechanism of action, approval status); retrieve gene expression and drug-versus-vehicle differential expression; and get perturbation markers, pathway scores, phenotype readouts (relative depletion, cell cycle, heterogeneity) and embedding distance from vehicle. Bounded retrieval with provenance, plus guarded read-only SQL and analysis guidance.
